metadata.title: Infrastructure reliability incident investigation
metadata.artifact_scope_note: Evidence is aggregated query output (not raw log lines or metric samples); it contains no chat/communication records.

incident_description: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Helix Analytics; Platform: bare-metal Kubernetes cluster bm-prod (on-premises, 24 workers), node range 10.60.0.0/16 (racks R20-R24); Workloads: Spark-on-Kubernetes batch ETL orchestrated by etl-scheduler, and a Trino query service used by report-portal; Hardware telemetry: IPMI SEL and EDAC kernel messages are forwarded to Elasticsearch; Change management: CHG- (software) and DC- (data-center) identifiers.
investigation_questions: What is the hostname of the host or node where the failure originated?
What is the IP address of the host or node where the failure originated?
Which memory module (DIMM slot) did the hardware event log identify?
Which Kubernetes node condition was reported for the failing node?
During what hour did the first signs of the failure appear? Provide the earliest date and time in YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM UTC format.

What is the root cause category of the incident: configuration change, software defect, hardware failure, cloud provider failure, capacity exhaustion, automation error, certificate expiry, or third-party dependency failure?
Which of the three CIA components is primarily affected: availability, integrity, or confidentiality?
According to the error volume statistics, what single service emitted the most errors? Is it the root cause or a downstream symptom?
Which deployment occurred shortly before the first kernel panic but was unrelated? Provide its change identifier.
